verdict.rationale: Three.js ships its own WebGL and WebGPU renderers and node-based materials, including MeshStandardNodeMaterial, so there is a documented first-party renderer core. The pack never states that this material is PBR, and it gives no evidence of shadows, post-processing, or global illumination/baked lighting. The community lightmap item is only a question, so it adds nothing. missing for 10: explicit PBR material documentation, shadow support, post-processing pipeline, GI or baked lightmap support, hands-on corroboration of production-quality rendering.

support.subject: As a game developer, the engine ships a modern production 3D renderer — PBR materials, global illumination or baked lighting, shadows, post-processing

citations.quote: The current builds only include WebGL and WebGPU renderers
